008package convert;
009
010import java.nio.file.*;
011import java.util.*;
012
013/**
014 * Specialized converter for the tracks table.
015 */
016public final class TracksConverter {
017
018    //private final Path inputDir;
019    private final Path inputFile;
020    private final Path outputFile;
021
022    public TracksConverter(Path inputDir) {
023        //this.inputDir = inputDir;
024        this.inputFile = inputDir.resolve("All Tracks.csv");
025        this.outputFile = inputDir.resolve("Tracks.csv");
026    }
027
028    // Old → New header mapping
029    private static final Map<String,String> MAP = new LinkedHashMap<>();
030    static {
031        MAP.put("Unique Key",                 "Unique Key");
032        MAP.put("Ext Recording Name",         "Recording Name");
033        MAP.put("Track Id",                   "Track Id");
034        MAP.put("Nr Spots",                   "Number of Spots");
035        MAP.put("Nr Gaps",                    "Number of Gaps");
036        MAP.put("Longest Gap",                "Longest Gap");
037        MAP.put("Track Duration",             "Track Duration");
038        MAP.put("Track X Location",           "Track X Location");
039        MAP.put("Track Y Location",           "Track Y Location");
040        MAP.put("Track Displacement",         "Track Displacement");
041        MAP.put("Track Max Speed",            "Track Max Speed");
042        MAP.put("Track Median Speed",         "Track Median Speed");
043        MAP.put("Diffusion Coefficient",      "Diffusion Coefficient");
044        MAP.put("Diffusion Coefficient Ext",  "Diffusion Coefficient Ext");
045        MAP.put("Total Distance",             "Total Distance");
046        MAP.put("Confinement Ratio",          "Confinement Ratio");
047        MAP.put("Square Nr",                  "Square Number");
048        MAP.put("Label Nr",                   "Label Number");
049    }
050
051    // Output header: Unique Key, Experiment Name, then mapped fields
052    public List<String> getOutputHeader() {
053        List<String> header = new ArrayList<>();
054        header.add("Unique Key");
055        header.add("Experiment Name");
056        for (Map.Entry<String,String> e : MAP.entrySet()) {
057            if (!"Unique Key".equals(e.getKey())) {
058                header.add(e.getValue());
059            }
060        }
061        return header;
062    }
063
064    // -----------------------------------------------------------
065    // Convert logic
066    // -----------------------------------------------------------
067    public List<Map<String,String>> convert(List<Map<String,String>> src) {
068        List<Map<String,String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
069
070        for (Map<String,String> r : src) {
071
072            String unique = r.get("Unique Key");
073            String experimentName = "";
074
075            if (unique != null && unique.length() >= 6) {
076                experimentName = unique.substring(0, 6);
077            }
078
079            Map<String,String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
080
081            // 1. Unique Key — EXACT COPY (no trim)
082            row.put("Unique Key", unique);
083
084            // 2. Constructed Experiment Name
085            row.put("Experiment Name", experimentName);
086
087            // 3. Remaining mapped fields
088            for (Map.Entry<String,String> e : MAP.entrySet()) {
089
090                String oldH = e.getKey();
091                String newH = e.getValue();
092
093                if ("Unique Key".equals(oldH)) {
094                    continue; // already handled
095                }
096
097                String val = r.get(oldH);
098
099                // Strip "-Threshold..." from Recording Name
100                switch (newH) {
101                    case "Recording Name":
102                        row.put(newH, stripThresholdSuffix(val));
103                        continue;
104
105
106                        // INTEGER normalization
107                    case "Number of Spots":
108                    case "Number of Gaps":
109                    case "Longest Gap":
110
111                        row.put(newH, toIntOrEmpty(val));
112                        continue;
113
114
115                        // DOUBLE normalization
116                    case "Track Duration":
117                    case "Track X Location":
118                    case "Track Y Location":
119                    case "Track Displacement":
120                    case "Track Max Speed":
121                    case "Track Median Speed":
122                    case "Diffusion Coefficient":
123                    case "Diffusion Coefficient Ext":
124                    case "Total Distance":
125                    case "Confinement Ratio":
126
127                        row.put(newH, toDoubleOrEmpty(val));
128                        continue;
129                }
130
131                // Default
132                row.put(newH, safe(val));
133            }
134
135            out.add(row);
136        }
137
138        return out;
139    }
140
141    // -----------------------------------------------------------
142    // Helpers
143    // -----------------------------------------------------------
144
145    private static String safe(String v) {
146        return v == null ? "" : v.trim();
147    }
148
149    private static String toIntOrEmpty(String v) {
150        if (v == null) return "";
151        v = v.trim();
152        if (v.isEmpty()) return "";
153        try {
154            double d = Double.parseDouble(v);
155            int i = (int) d;
156            return Integer.toString(i);
157        } catch (Exception ex) {
158            return "";
159        }
160    }
161
162    private static String toDoubleOrEmpty(String v) {
163        if (v == null) return "";
164        v = v.trim();
165        if (v.isEmpty()) return "";
166        try {
167            double d = Double.parseDouble(v);
168            return Double.toString(d);
169        } catch (Exception ex) {
170            return "";
171        }
172    }
173
174    private static String stripThresholdSuffix(String v) {
175        if (v == null) return "";
176        v = v.trim();
177        if (v.isEmpty()) return v;
178
179        int idx = v.toLowerCase().lastIndexOf("-threshold");
180        if (idx == -1) return v;
181
182        return v.substring(0, idx).trim();
183    }
184
185    // -----------------------------------------------------------
186    // Runner
187    // -----------------------------------------------------------
188    public void run() throws Exception {
189        System.out.println("Reading:  " + inputFile);
190        List<Map<String,String>> src = CsvIO.readSimpleCsv(inputFile);
191
192        System.out.println("Converting Tracks (" + src.size() + " rows)...");
193        List<Map<String,String>> out = convert(src);
194
195        System.out.println("Writing:  " + outputFile);
196        CsvIO.writeSimpleCsv(outputFile, getOutputHeader(), out);
197
198        System.out.println("✔ Tracks conversion complete.");
199    }
200}
